detail.title: Kernel Governance and Durable Record Mechanisms for WAKE Process Continuity
detail.summary: This revision examines the durable record implementation, comparing version 44 and version 64 to assess how the system manages state transitions. The records demonstrate a consistent architecture for owning authoritative history.
detail.reason: Revision of the WAKE continuity notebook to incorporate new durable record evidence from version 64, satisfying the study's requirements for process continuity analysis.
